s01.definition: the highest legal authority in a country, above all other laws
s01.example: The Constitution is the supreme law of the land.
s01.visual: A colonial town square: a citizen in a long coat standing before a tall columned building, looking up at a large balance scale mounted above the entrance, one pan holding a rolled parchment scroll and the other a small crown, the scroll side weighing lower, soft morning light, Oxford textbook illustration, no text anywhere

s02.definition: to reply to a question; the correct reply
s02.visual: A close-up of a hand unrolling a parchment scroll across a wooden desk to reveal a red round wax seal, an inkwell and quill beside it, warm light from a nearby window, a second rolled scroll in the background, Oxford textbook illustration, no text or letters anywhere

s03.definition: to be real or present in the world
s03.visual: A historical scene of the American coastline around 1787: a wooden sailing ship anchored near a wild forested shore, several small scattered colonial houses and a church steeple along the beach, vast untouched forest stretching inland, no modern cities, soft sunrise light, Oxford textbook illustration, no text anywhere
